capabilities: Automatically fix relative links after a file is moved
Batch fix links in all files to relative paths via command
Make notes portable across other Markdown editors and Git web views
extras: Only works when the 'Use [[Wikilinks]]' setting is off, since the plugin operates on Markdown-style relative links; includes a Chinese-language version of the README.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's implementation of the "Automatically update internal links" option is buggy.
motivation: The author built it because Obsidian's built-in 'Automatically update internal links' option is buggy and only handles links to the moved file.
problem: Obsidian's automatic internal link updating only rewrites links pointing to a moved file, not links inside that file to other files, leaving broken relative paths behind.
summary: Link fixer that updates relative Markdown paths when files move, plus a command to batch-convert all links to relative paths.
